sections.text: Robotics Software Intern, Vayu Robotics (Jan 2026 - Jun 2026). Developed and maintained ROS 2 Humble nodes for an autonomous mobile robot, including a Nav2-based navigation stack and sensor fusion between LiDAR and wheel odometry. Wrote the Python tooling used to replay and analyse recorded runs. Collaborated through a shared GitLab repository using a branching workflow with code review.

Autonomous Mobile Robot - built a differential-drive robot running ROS 2 Humble with Nav2 path planning and a Gazebo simulation environment for testing. Implemented an OpenCV pipeline for cone detection used during navigation.
B.Tech Mechatronics, 2026. Coursework included Robotics, Control Systems and Computer Vision.
I am an expert in AWS and cloud infrastructure. I am proficient in ROS 2 and Python from my internship and personal projects.
